captureMethod: Each renderer was executed in Chromium against index.html loaded directly from the named production commit. The resulting print-root innerHTML was whitespace-canonicalized and SHA-256 hashed. PDF bytes are deliberately excluded because Chromium PDF metadata and object ordering are platform-dependent.

avsSheet.note: Intentionally diverges from the production commit. The injection After Visit Summary now uses a mature clinical-document hierarchy with a semantic patient band, dated treatment timeline, restrained due-date emphasis, and deterministic routine/complex pages. Patient wording and timeline rules remain in src/domain/injection-avs-content.ts; semantic markup remains in src/domain/injection-avs-render.ts. Every other print root in this fixture is still pinned to production output.

injWorksheetSheet.note: Intentionally diverges from the production commit. Medication source is now a required field for a documented administration (previously optional), so the worksheet's product-handling section prints a populated 'Product source' line for this fixture instead of omitting it.
